description: Source code for the HpackWholeEntryBuffer class, which handles HPACK header decoding in HTTP/2, including buffer management, error handling, and listener callbacks.

classes.name: HpackWholeEntryBuffer
classes.description: Class responsible for decoding and buffering HPACK header entries in HTTP/2, managing state, error detection, and notifying a listener.

methods.name: set_listener
methods.description: Sets the listener for header decoding events.

methods.name: set_max_string_size_bytes
methods.description: Sets the maximum allowed size for header name and value strings.

methods.name: BufferStringsIfUnbuffered
methods.description: Buffers the header name and value strings if they are not already buffered.

methods.name: OnIndexedHeader
methods.description: Handles an indexed header by notifying the listener.

methods.name: OnStartLiteralHeader
methods.description: Begins processing a literal header, recording its type and optional name index.

methods.name: OnNameStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a header name, checking length constraints.

methods.name: OnNameData
methods.description: Processes header name data, with error handling for Huffman errors.

methods.name: OnNameEnd
methods.description: Finalizes header name processing, checking for errors.

methods.name: OnValueStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a header value, checking length constraints.

methods.name: OnValueData
methods.description: Processes header value data, with error handling for Huffman errors.

methods.name: OnValueEnd
methods.description: Finalizes header value processing and notifies the listener.

methods.name: ReportError
methods.description: Reports a decoding error and notifies the listener.
